description: Publish every record a domain needs (identity or delegation TXT, DKIM CNAMEs, MAIL FROM MX/SPF, and DMARC if missing) using the operator's Vercel or Cloudflare token from this server's environment (VERCEL_TOKEN [+ VERCEL_TEAM_ID] or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN). The token is used locally and never sent to SendForAI. Omit domain to set up the identity domain; pass another domain to add it to this account. Safe to repeat. If no token is configured, use get_domain_status / add_domain and hand the records to your operator instead.
name: setup_dns
title: Publish DNS records automatically
